# AI Data Cleaning and EDA Agent - Workspace Instructions

This workspace contains an AI-powered data cleaning and exploratory data analysis agent designed for machine learning workflows and Amazon ML challenges.

## Project Overview
- **Purpose**: Intelligent data preprocessing, quality assessment, and automated EDA
- **Target**: ML competitions, data science projects, Amazon ML challenges  
- **Key Features**: AI-driven data cleaning, automated insights, smart feature engineering

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on automated data quality assessment
- Implement intelligent preprocessing pipelines
- Create interactive EDA dashboards
- Support multiple data formats (CSV, JSON, Parquet, etc.)
- Optimize for ML workflow integration
